Now I understand the vulnerability. In `ProcessService`:
- `cfg.mServiceData` is a fixed-size buffer of 252 bytes
- `cfg.mServiceDataLength = static_cast<uint8_t>(strlen(argv[2]))` - this truncates the length to 8 bits (max 255)
- `memcpy(cfg.mServiceData, argv[2], cfg.mServiceDataLength)` - copies the full length without checking against the buffer size

If `argv[2]` is longer than 252 bytes, this will overflow the stack buffer `cfg.mServiceData`.

Similarly, `cfg.mServerConfig.mServerData` is 248 bytes, and `cfg.mServerConfig.mServerDataLength = static_cast<uint8_t>(strlen(argv[3]))` with `memcpy(cfg.mServerConfig.mServerData, argv[3], cfg.mServerConfig.mServerDataLength)` has the same issue.
